headlines.title: 양극화 완화 TF 가동 …“ 재정·세제·금융·규제개선 등에 집중 ”
headlines.summary: 이형일 경제부총리 겸 재정경제부 장관이 이끄는 양극화 대응 태스크포스(TF)가 본격적인 활동을 시작했습니다. 권대영 재정경제부 1차관과 현수엽 보건복지부 1차관은 오늘(12일) 오전 정부서울청사에서 관계 부처 및 청와대 당국자가 참석한 가운데 ‘양극화 대응 TF’ 총괄반 첫 회의를 열었습니다.

headlines.title: 정부, 양극화 대응 TF 가동 … 5대 분야 격차 완화책 연내 마련

headlines.title: 美 의회, ' 반도체 수출 통제 3법' 탄력...韓 업체에도 불똥 튀나
headlines.summary: [파이낸셜뉴스] 젠슨 황(왼쪽) 엔비디아 최고경영자(CEO)가 대만 타이베이에서 지난해 5월 22일(현지시간) 주최한 만찬에 앨리스 황이 참석해 미소 짓고 있다. AP 뉴시스 미국 의회의 대중국 반도체 수출 규제 강화 3법에 다시 탄력이 붙고 있다고 월스트리트저널(WSJ)이 11일(현지시간) 보도했다.

headlines.title: 반도체 호황 누른 유가 … KDI " 소비에 부정적 영향 먼저 반영 "
headlines.summary: 올해 유가 탓 소비 증가율 0.4%p↓…내년 반도체로 소비 증가율 0.6%p↑ "최고가격제, 3∼10월 소비자물가 상승률 평균 약 0.6%p 낮춰" "추가 수요 진작정책 필요성 크지 않아…비반도체 임금 여건 개선해야" 석유 최고가격제 12차 최고가격 발표 앞둔 주유소 (서울=연합뉴스) 박동주 기자 = 12일 서울 서초구 만남의광장 주유소에 유가가 표시돼있다

headlines.title: 반도체 호황 온기는 '아직' … 유가 충격에 민간소비 회복 '발목'
headlines.summary: 핵심요약 KDI, '최근 반도체 호황과 유가 상승이 민간소비에 미치는 영향' 보고서 KDI "반도체 효과는 4분기 뒤 나타나…올해 유가 충격에 소비 증가율 0.4%p 하락" 내년 반도체 효과 0.6%p 상승 전망…임금 정체·금리 부담은 변수 한국개발연구원(KDI) 경제전망실 김지연(가운데) 전망총괄 및 마창석(왼쪽)·이승희 연구위원.

headlines.title: 9월만 법인세 36조 걷혀 … 나라살림 적자 1년새 70조 축소
headlines.summary: 1~9월 32조 적자, 1년새 70.5조↓ 기업 호실적에 누적 법인세 52조↑ 중앙정부 채무 1369조, 101조 증가 기업 실적 개선에 따른 법인세 급증으로 올해 1~9월 나라살림 적자가 1년 새 70조원 넘게 줄었다. 9월 한 달에만 법인세가 36조원 넘게 걷히면서 월간 재정수지가 적자에서 흑자로 돌아섰다.

headlines.title: 국제금융기구 채용설명회 … 13개 기관 한국 찾아 면접 · 컨설팅

headlines.title: 내년 전국 오피스텔 기준시가 4년째 하락 … 서울은 2%대 상승

headlines.title: 서울 집합건물 증여받은 20대 1년새 2.2배↑

headlines.title: 한국 관광 새 역사…외국인 관광객 2000만명 돌파
headlines.summary: 2012년 1000만명 달성 이후 14년 만에 문체부, ‘대체불가 관광대국’ 도약 본격화 올해 한국을 찾은 외국인 관광객이 사상 첫 2000만명을 돌파했다. 외국인 관광객수는 지난해에 이어 2년 연속 역대 최다 기록을 경신했다. 문화체육관광부는 12일 지난 2012년 외래관광객 1000만명 시대를 연 지 14년 만에 2000만명을 돌파했다고 밝혔다.

key_headlines.title: US Congress Pushes Forward with Three Semiconductor Export Control Laws Targeting China
key_headlines.summary: The US Congress is accelerating three bills to strengthen semiconductor export controls to China, which could have spillover effects on Korean semiconductor companies. The Wall Street Journal reported on these strengthened measures affecting the global chip industry.

key_headlines.title: High Oil Prices Dampening Consumer Spending Despite Semiconductor Boom
key_headlines.summary: The Korea Development Institute reports that rising oil prices reduced consumer spending growth by 0.4 percentage points this year, offsetting expected benefits from semiconductor industry recovery. The semiconductor boom's positive impact is expected to emerge in Q4 and contribute 0.6 percentage points to consumption growth next year.

key_headlines.title: Government Launches Multi-Ministry Task Force to Address Income Inequality Across Five Sectors
key_headlines.summary: The government has activated a comprehensive task force led by Deputy Prime Minister Lee Hyung-kyung to address polarization in labor market, industries, regions, generations, and society. The initiative will integrate fiscal, tax, financial, and regulatory improvement policies into the 2027 economic growth strategy.

key_headlines.title: Korea's Q3 GDP Growth Accelerates to 1.0% Quarter-on-Quarter, Exceeding Expectations
key_headlines.summary: South Korea's third quarter real GDP growth rate reached 1.0% quarter-on-quarter, significantly outperforming market expectations of 0.3% and reflecting strong performance in exports and investments. Cumulative growth for the first three quarters reached 3.6%, prompting the government to upgrade its economic assessment from recovery to sustained growth.

key_headlines.title: Naver Struggles with Advertising Business Decline Despite Record Revenue
key_headlines.summary: Naver recorded record third-quarter revenue of 3.47 trillion won but operating profit fell over 20%, indicating the maturity of its core advertising and commerce businesses. The company is pivoting toward AI agents, B2B services, and cloud computing as new growth drivers to diversify revenue streams.

sections.Hot Economy News: South Korea's economic outlook has brightened significantly with Q3 GDP growth accelerating to 1.0% quarter-on-quarter, well above market expectations, driven by robust exports and investment performance. The government has upgraded its economic assessment from recovery phase to sustained growth, with cumulative growth for the first three quarters reaching 3.6%. October employment figures showed improvement with 139,000 new jobs created and unemployment rates declining, though consumer price inflation remains at 2.8%. A multi-ministry task force has been activated to address income inequality across labor, industry, regional, generational, and social sectors as a priority policy initiative.
sections.Macro & Fiscal Policy: The Korean government upgraded its economic assessment based on stronger-than-expected Q3 GDP growth of 1.0% quarter-on-quarter, with exports and investments driving the performance. October employment data showed positive momentum with 139,000 additional jobs created and unemployment falling to 2.0%, though wage stagnation and interest rate burdens remain concerns for consumer spending. Import prices declined 1.8% due to falling oil prices and won appreciation, while export volume growth reached a record 43.9% year-on-year increase. The government established a comprehensive polarization response task force spanning fiscal, tax, financial, and regulatory improvements to address inequality in five major sectors.
sections.Financial Markets: The KOSPI declined amid foreign investor selling despite opening strongly, as investors digested global concerns about Fed interest rate trajectory and geopolitical tensions over Iran. The KOSDAQ showed resilience with smaller losses after an initial rally, as semiconductor stocks like Samsung Electronics and SK Hynix initially surged but retreated on foreign selling pressure. The won-dollar exchange rate tested re-entry into the 1,330s range as market focus shifted from rate cut expectations to the magnitude and timing of potential Fed rate increases in December. Nvidia's 4.34% decline following CEO Jensen Huang's resignation, combined with rising US Treasury yields above 5.1% and elevated oil prices, weighed on global risk sentiment.
sections.Industry & Technology: South Korea is accelerating plans to develop eight homegrown AI chips by 2030 with government-private sector cooperation, focusing on autonomous vehicles and appliance applications with Samsung providing priority allocation of 2-nanometer processes. SFC, a materials specialist company, is expanding beyond OLED blue materials into biotech and semiconductor materials while turning profitable in its biotech division. The government's AI semiconductor alliance (M.AX) received approvals for three key divisions including manufacturing and defense sectors. GS Construction's battery recycling subsidiary suspended operations after profitability deteriorated due to EV demand stagnation, with the parent company absorbing 112.5 billion won in debt and interest payments.
sections.Real Estate: Housing prices in the Han River belt areas including Seongdong and Gangdong districts have reversed course and declined for the first time in 30 weeks after being driven up alongside Gangnam properties, signaling potential price adjustment phases in secondary markets. Seoul's apartment transaction prices index continued its 92-week consecutive gains streak despite the emerging decline trend in some districts, as survival purchases remain concentrated in outer Seoul areas due to jeonse (long-term lease) shortages. The former CBS broadcast station site in Mokdong will be developed into senior housing and commercial facilities instead of knowledge industry centers, reflecting changing real estate conditions. Concerns arose regarding improper apartment allocation procedures with official investigations underway on related political figures.
sections.International Economy: The Federal Reserve announced its 2027 FOMC meeting schedule with eight sessions total, but reduced rate-decision meetings from eight to seven, with October devoted solely to monetary policy strategy discussion. Fed officials including Christopher Waller signaled potential 0.50 percentage point rate increases in December, shifting market focus from rate cut possibilities to increase magnitude and future policy paths. President Trump demanded that Mexico halt illegal immigration flows or face doubled tariffs, escalating trade tensions with Mexico and other Central American nations. The US recorded a 539 trillion won monthly fiscal deficit in October, representing a 42% year-on-year increase and bringing annual deficits to approximately 6% of GDP.
sections.AI & Economy: Sision AI, an AI specialist company, simultaneously received approvals for three key divisions in the government's M.AX Alliance including manufacturing, defense, and factory automation sectors, positioning the company to expand AI solutions supply to the manufacturing ecosystem. Naver is facing pressure to transition from its mature advertising and commerce businesses toward new growth drivers including personal AI agents, B2B services, and cloud computing amid operating profit declines exceeding 20% despite record revenue. Small and medium enterprises are being strategically positioned to participate in the government's three mega-projects worth 1,500 trillion won including semiconductors, AI data centers, and physical AI infrastructure development. Hettofinance is being recognized for growth potential in stable coin and AI agent payment settlement businesses alongside its core payment operations, with expanded global payment infrastructure serving as a medium-term growth driver.
sections.Others: Hanwha Investment & Asset Management launched target-date funds with 2050, 2060, and 2070 vintages focusing on AI value chain investments with hedging flexibility for foreign assets. Chinese companies circumvented US semiconductor export controls by importing at least 7.5 billion dollars worth of Nvidia chips since 2023, including recent advanced Blackwell chips, with approximately 30 Chinese tech companies and state-owned enterprises participating in DeepSeek's second funding round. Nvidia's leadership faces uncertainty following CEO Jensen Huang's resignation over infidelity scandal, particularly regarding the company's large-scale AI investments and financial support programs that Huang directly championed and led. Korea Aerospace Industries expanded aviation industry cooperation with Indonesia's PTDI, signing three MOUs and delivering six additional T-50i aircraft, bringing cumulative supplies to 22 units.
